text:
maria: Heads-up from enterprise pilots: three customers asked for per-tenant audit segregation, two insist on BYOK, and four asked for multi-year retention (5-7yrs). Also a healthcare pilot wants region-bound retention. Notes here: https://tiny.redwood/enterprise-pilots :mag_right:

ben: For clarity — BYOK vs BYOK+escrow are different commitments. Escrow triggers legal/ops workflows. Customers keep pushing escrow as a must for certain regulated deals.

devin: Tech take: per-tenant audit partitioning doable by adding tenant_id to ingestion pipeline and creating per-tenant shards. Impact: index count goes up; cold query path remains unchanged. Estimate: 2 SWE + 1 infra 3 weeks for MVP (no fancy cross-tenant analytics).

priya: If we offer 5-7yr retention we need retention tiers (hot/warm/cold) + retrieval SLA. Sales will want price bands. Also callout: retention interacts with key rotation policy and proof-of-deletion contractual language.

legal-bot: Reminder from contracts: escrow access language needs to define release conditions, required approvals, audit trail retention, and jurisdictional constraints.

maria: Proposal for sprint splits (opinionated):
- Sprint 1: per-tenant audit partitions (MVP), retention TTL hooks into cold archive, and a short doc for sales on tradeoffs.
- Sprint 2: BYOK onboarding UX + API, BYOK verification flows, docs for rotation and emergency revoke. Manual escrow process for pilot (ops-mediated).
- Sprint 3: Escrow automation (connector to approved KMS providers), multi-region retention policy UI, SOC2/ISO evidence packaging support.

ben: Risks: shard explosion, prefix cache invalidation, and reading across many small shards will hurt aggregated queries. Also storage churn forecast for 7yr retention needs modeling.

devin: Agree. I'll run storage-growth sim and query perf delta with 20 tenants and synthetic 7yr dataset.

priya: Sales asks: give me a quick pricing stub: suggested cold-storage $/GiB/mo and a retrieval fee estimate. Also need bullet points for what is included in "archival search" vs "hot search".

nora: Ops note: BYOK onboarding currently requires a manual handshake and HSM verification in some cases. Can script steps into a guided console flow, but that's separate UX ticket.

maria: Prioritization (one-liner):
- Must for current Fin/Healthcare pilots: BYOK onboarding + per-tenant audit partitioning.
- High: configurable long-term retention as billed add-on with defined cold-query SLA.
- Medium: automated escrow connector.
- Low: cross-tenant analytics over cold archive.

ben: Security owners need a threat model doc for BYOK+escrow (import, rotation, emergency revoke, escrow-release audit). I'll volunteer to draft it.

legal-bot: Legal needs product to pick between two escrow models: (A) escrow release by court order only, or (B) customer-authorized release with dual-signer ops workflow. Each has different timelines and compliance exposure.

maria: Action items: @devin produce perf & storage sim by Tue; @ben draft BYOK+escrow threat model; @priya prepare pricing stub and sales bullet points; @nora spec BYOK onboarding console flow. I'll consolidate into a 1-pager for the roadmap review.

sales-bot: FYI — two deals will go to term sheet if we can commit to at least manual escrow + 5yr retention with pricing.

maria: We'll treat this thread as canonical for scoping. Drop any new customer commitments or legal constraints here. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
